criteria.text: Treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE).
Documented diagnosis of hereditary angioedema (HAE) by an immunologist.
Recipient is on prophylactic therapy (such as 17-α-alkylated androgens or antifibrinolytic agents) unless contraindicated or response failure.

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Firazyr Criteria Version 1; Last updated 3/2/2012; Approved 03/16/2012. The effective_date 2023-01-02 is retained from the archived stub and is not the PDF approval date.
A letter of medical necessity and all necessary documentation substantiating every approval criterion are required; document verification remains manual review.

Prophylactic therapy examples include 17-α-alkylated androgens or antifibrinolytic agents. Contraindication or response failure is an exception to current prophylactic therapy; verify supporting documentation manually.
Length of authorization: coverage may be approved for date of service. Authorization enforcement remains manual review.
Dispensing limit: 3 units. Refills require documentation of Emergency Room or Hospital intervention. Quantity and refill documentation remain manual review.
Berinert is an acute HAE treatment alternative requiring separate evaluation under its own indication and criteria.
